name: Visual Novel
summary: Talk with Gwen, an AI visual-novel character who answers as a scene: her expression, where you are, her line in the dialogue box.
description:
Visual Novel turns chat into a visual novel. Type !vn and a message, and Gwen answers with a scene: one of her 11 expressions, picked by the AI to match what she says, in one of 7 places (bridge, swing, grove, path, greenhouse, house, table), with her line in the dialogue box. The same line is in the message as text, so it's easy to read on a phone. Reply to her scene to keep talking. Long answers get ◀️ ▶️ page reactions, and 🗺️ opens the map: react 1-7 to walk somewhere together, or use !vngo grove. Everyone has their own scene and conversation. !vnreset makes her forget yours, and !vnface shows an expression. List channels under "Chat in these channels" and she answers every message there, no command needed. Change her name and personality in the settings to make her someone else.

Needs an Ollama API key (ollama.com, free tier works) in the bot's .env as OLLAMA_API_KEY, or a local Ollama. Her pictures (about 1.4 MB) are downloaded from this marketplace the first time she's needed and kept. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code. Rewritten from atorsvn/visual_novel_chat_poc.

"""Draw visual-novel screens in memory: place, expression, dialogue box with paged text, status line and the map."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import re
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 720, 540
SPRITE_AT = (108, 0)
TEXT_BOX = (150, 336, 668, 506)          # inside the chat overlay, right of the small portrait
LINE_GAP = 1.22

PLACES = {
    "bridge": "an old iron bridge in a park, under pink autumn trees",
    "swing": "a wooden swing at the edge of the park, among tall bushes",
    "grove": "a quiet grove of tall red trees",
    "path": "a leafy path in the park that leads into the woods",
    "greenhouse": "a warm greenhouse full of plants",
    "house": "outside a cosy little house",
    "table": "a small table, sitting across from each other",
}
MOODS = ["normal", "smile", "smile_2", "delighted", "laugh", "smug", "shocked", "sad", "annoyed", "angry", "sleepy"]


class Art:
    """The module's pictures and font, loaded once and kept in memory."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path):
        self.root = Path(root)

    @lru_cache(maxsize=64)
    def get(self, rel: str) -> Image.Image:
        for ext in (".webp", ".png", ".jpg"):
            p = self.root / f"{rel}{ext}"
            if p.is_file():
                im = Image.open(p)
                im.load()
                return im.convert("RGBA")
        raise FileNotFoundError(rel)

    @lru_cache(maxsize=16)
    def font(self, size: int) -> ImageFont.FreeTypeFont:
        for p in (self.root / "OpenSansEmoji.ttf", Path("DejaVuSans.ttf")):
            try:
                return ImageFont.truetype(str(p), size)
            except OSError:
                pass
        return ImageFont.load_default(size)

    @lru_cache(maxsize=96)
    def stage(self, place: str, mood: str) -> Image.Image:
        """Background, character and dialogue box composited once per place and expression."""
        base = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 255))
        base.alpha_composite(self.get(f"backgrounds/{place}").resize((W, H)))
        base.alpha_composite(self.get(f"sprites/{mood}"), SPRITE_AT)
        base.alpha_composite(self.get("ui/chat"))
        return base


def wrap(draw, text: str, font, width: int) -> list[str]:
    lines: list[str] = []
    for para in text.split("\n"):
        line = ""
        for word in para.split():
            trial = f"{line} {word}".strip()
            if draw.textlength(trial, font=font) <= width or not line:
                line = trial
            else:
                lines.append(line)
                line = word
        lines.append(line)
    return [ln for ln in lines if ln.strip()]


def paginate(text: str, art: Art, size: int = 24) -> list[str]:
    """Split ``text`` into pages that each fit the dialogue box."""
    font = art.font(size)
    probe = ImageDraw.Draw(Image.new("RGB", (1, 1)))
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = TEXT_BOX
    per = max(1, int((y1 - y0 - 26 - 22) // (size * LINE_GAP)))
    lines = wrap(probe, clean(text), font, x1 - x0)
    return ["\n".join(lines[i:i + per]) for i in range(0, len(lines), per)] or ["…"]


def clean(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[*_`#>]+", "", text or "")          # markdown would show as symbols on the picture
    return re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", text).strip()


def screen(art: Art, place: str, mood: str, page: str, status: str, page_no: int = 1, pages: int = 1,
           speaker: str = "") -> bytes:
    im = art.stage(place, mood).copy()
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    f = art.font(24)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = TEXT_BOX
    if speaker:
        d.text((x0, y0 - 2), speaker, font=art.font(20), fill=(255, 196, 214))
        y0 += 26
    for i, line in enumerate(page.split("\n")):
        d.text((x0, y0 + i * 24 * LINE_GAP), line, font=f, fill="white")
    if pages > 1:
        tag = f"{page_no}/{pages}"
        tw = d.textlength(tag, font=art.font(18))
        d.text((x1 - tw, y1 - 4), tag, font=art.font(18), fill=(220, 220, 230))
    sf = art.font(22)
    tw = d.textlength(status, font=sf)
    d.text(((W - tw) / 2, 24), status, font=sf, fill="white")
    return encode(im)


def map_screen(art: Art, here: str, status: str) -> bytes:
    """Every place as a numbered thumbnail over the current scene."""
    im = art.get(f"backgrounds/{here}").resize((W, H)).copy()
    im.alpha_composite(Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (10, 10, 20, 170)))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    names = list(PLACES)
    cols, tw, th, gap = 4, 150, 112, 18
    rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
    top = 80 + (H - 80 - rows * (th + 34) - (rows - 1) * gap) // 2
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        r, c = divmod(i, cols)
        n_in_row = min(cols, len(names) - r * cols)
        left = (W - n_in_row * tw - (n_in_row - 1) * gap) // 2
        x, y = left + c * (tw + gap), top + r * (th + 34 + gap)
        thumb = art.get(f"backgrounds/{name}").resize((tw, th))
        mask = Image.new("L", (tw, th), 0)
        ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle([0, 0, tw - 1, th - 1], 12, fill=255)
        im.paste(thumb, (x, y), mask)
        d.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + tw - 1, y + th - 1], 12,
                            outline=(255, 196, 214) if name == here else (255, 255, 255), width=4 if name == here else 2)
        num = str(i + 1)
        nf = art.font(46)
        d.text((x + (tw - d.textlength(num, font=nf)) / 2, y + 22), num, font=nf, fill="white",
               stroke_width=3, stroke_fill=(0, 0, 0))
        lf = art.font(19)
        label = name.capitalize()
        d.text((x + (tw - d.textlength(label, font=lf)) / 2, y + th + 4), label, font=lf, fill="white")
    sf = art.font(22)
    w = d.textlength(status, font=sf)
    d.text(((W - w) / 2, 24), status, font=sf, fill="white")
    return encode(im)


def encode(im: Image.Image) -> bytes:
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    im.convert("RGB").save(buf, "JPEG", quality=87, optimize=True)
    return buf.getvalue()

"""What she says and how she looks saying it: the system prompt, the mood tag, and a keyword fallback."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from .scene import MOODS, PLACES

TAG = re.compile(r"^\s*\[(\w+)\]\s*", re.I)
KEYWORDS = {
    "laugh": ["haha", "hehe", "lol", "funny", "laugh"],
    "delighted": ["yay", "amazing", "wonderful", "love it", "so happy", "!!"],
    "smug": ["obviously", "of course", "told you", "hmph", "smug"],
    "shocked": ["what?!", "wait", "really?", "no way", "whoa", "surprise"],
    "sad": ["sorry", "sad", "miss", "lonely", "cry", "unfortunately"],
    "annoyed": ["ugh", "seriously", "annoying", "whatever", "sigh"],
    "angry": ["angry", "how dare", "stop it", "furious", "idiot"],
    "sleepy": ["sleepy", "tired", "yawn", "bed", "late"],
    "smile_2": ["blush", "embarrass", "senpai", "cute"],
    "smile": ["happy", "glad", "nice", "thank", "sure", "of course"],
}


def system_prompt(name: str, persona: str, place: str, user: str) -> str:
    return (
        f"{persona.strip()}\n\n"
        f"You are {name}, a character in a visual novel. You are talking with {user}. "
        f"Right now you are both at {PLACES.get(place, place)}.\n"
        "Stay in character. Reply in 1 to 4 short sentences of natural speech, no lists, no markdown, "
        "no stage directions in asterisks.\n"
        "Start every reply with your expression in square brackets, one of: " + ", ".join(f"[{m}]" for m in MOODS)
        + ". For example: [smile] It's nice out here, isn't it?"
    )


def split_mood(reply: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(mood, text without the tag). Falls back to keywords when the model forgot the tag."""
    m = TAG.match(reply or "")
    if m and m.group(1).lower() in MOODS:
        return m.group(1).lower(), reply[m.end():].strip()
    text = TAG.sub("", reply or "").strip()
    return guess(text), text


def guess(text: str) -> str:
    low = (text or "").lower()
    best, hits = "normal", 0
    for mood, words in KEYWORDS.items():
        n = sum(low.count(w) for w in words)
        if n > hits:
            best, hits = mood, n
    return best


def place_from(text: str) -> str | None:
    """A place named (or numbered) in ``text``."""
    t = (text or "").strip().lower()
    names = list(PLACES)
    if t.isdigit() and 1 <= int(t) <= len(names):
        return names[int(t) - 1]
    for n in names:
        if n in t:
            return n
    return None
